ota_summary.en: The overview shows air readings and screen brightness. Wi-Fi, MQTT, binding, updates and diagnostics have separate settings pages; unsaved input survives page switches.

title.zh-CN: 修正 M1 网络图标
title.en: Correct M1 network indicators

description.zh-CN: 正常连接时 Wi-Fi 常亮、错误标志熄灭；Wi-Fi 故障同步闪烁，已配置的 MQTT 故障单独提示，未配置 MQTT 不报错。

ota_summary.zh-CN: 正常连接时 Wi-Fi 常亮、错误标志熄灭；Wi-Fi 故障同步闪烁，已配置的 MQTT 故障单独提示，未配置 MQTT 不报错。
ota_summary.en: Wi-Fi stays lit and the error icon is off during normal operation. Wi-Fi faults blink both icons; configured MQTT faults have a separate indication, and unconfigured MQTT does not report a fault.

title.zh-CN: 修复 MQTT 空闲与分包断线
title.en: Fix MQTT idle and fragmented-packet disconnects

description.zh-CN: 修复空闲超时误断线和 TCP 分包导致的 MQTT 断线，增加最近错误诊断。
description.en: Fixes incorrect idle timeouts and MQTT disconnects caused by fragmented TCP packets; recent errors are available for diagnosis.

ota_summary.zh-CN: 修复空闲超时误断线和 TCP 分包导致的 MQTT 断线，增加最近错误诊断。
ota_summary.en: Fixes incorrect idle timeouts and MQTT disconnects caused by fragmented TCP packets; recent errors are available for diagnosis.

title.zh-CN: 签名 OTA 与写入校验
title.en: Signed OTA and flash verification

description.zh-CN: 新增 P-256/SHA-256 签名 OTA，写入前验证签名、写入后核对 Flash 摘要及兼容性。旧固件首次过渡使用可信本地网页上传原生 OTA；完整 Flash 镜像不能用作网页 OTA。
description.en: Adds P-256/SHA-256 signed OTA with signature checks before writing and flash-digest and compatibility checks afterwards. For initial migration from older firmware, upload a native OTA image through a trusted local page; a full flash image is not a web OTA package.

ota_summary.zh-CN: 新增 P-256/SHA-256 签名 OTA，写入前验证签名、写入后核对 Flash 摘要及兼容性。旧固件首次过渡使用可信本地网页上传原生 OTA；完整 Flash 镜像不能用作网页 OTA。
ota_summary.en: Adds P-256/SHA-256 signed OTA with signature checks before writing and flash-digest and compatibility checks afterwards. For initial migration from older firmware, upload a native OTA image through a trusted local page; a full flash image is not a web OTA package.

title.zh-CN: 统一设备网页与中英文操作
title.en: Consistent device pages and languages

description.zh-CN: 统一设备网页的状态、读数、定时和按键设置，中英文操作保持一致。
description.en: Device pages share consistent status, readings, schedules and button settings in Chinese and English.

ota_summary.zh-CN: 统一设备网页的状态、读数、定时和按键设置，中英文操作保持一致。
ota_summary.en: Device pages share consistent status, readings, schedules and button settings in Chinese and English.

title.zh-CN: 改善 MQTT 回执与连接提示
title.en: Improve MQTT acknowledgements and connection status

ota_summary.zh-CN: 改进 MQTT 报文处理、命令回执与连接状态指示。
ota_summary.en: Improves MQTT packet handling, command acknowledgements and connection indicators.

title.zh-CN: 增加在线检查与国内外升级源
title.en: Online checks and regional update sources

description.zh-CN: 新增异步版本检查和签名固件下载入口，提供境内外 HTTP 来源；保留文件和 URL 升级。
description.en: Adds asynchronous version checks and signed firmware downloads from Chinese and global HTTP sources; file and URL updates remain available.

ota_summary.zh-CN: 新增异步版本检查和签名固件下载入口，提供境内外 HTTP 来源；保留文件和 URL 升级。
ota_summary.en: Adds asynchronous version checks and signed firmware downloads from Chinese and global HTTP sources; file and URL updates remain available.

title.zh-CN: 官网演示与历史下载
title.en: Website demos and historical downloads

description.zh-CN: 官网提供设备和平台演示、最新下载及按版本保留的归档。
description.en: The website provides device and platform demos, current downloads and versioned archives.

ota_summary.zh-CN: 官网提供设备和平台演示、最新下载及按版本保留的归档。
ota_summary.en: The website provides device and platform demos, current downloads and versioned archives.

title.zh-CN: GitHub Pages HTTPS 升级源
title.en: GitHub Pages HTTPS update source

description.zh-CN: 设备可直接从 GitHub Pages 检查版本、读取说明和下载签名 OTA，继续保留境内外 HTTP 来源。
description.en: Devices can check versions, read notes and download signed OTA from GitHub Pages over HTTPS; regional HTTP sources remain available.

ota_summary.zh-CN: 设备可直接从 GitHub Pages 检查版本、读取说明和下载签名 OTA，继续保留境内外 HTTP 来源。
ota_summary.en: Devices can check versions, read notes and download signed OTA from GitHub Pages over HTTPS; regional HTTP sources remain available.

title.zh-CN: 升级下载可取消并限制超时
title.en: Cancellable downloads with timeouts

description.zh-CN: DNS、连接及收发设置超时，失败或取消后恢复日常服务；提交启动镜像后不能取消，重试从头下载。
description.en: DNS, connection and I/O have timeouts. Failure or cancellation restores normal services; cancellation is unavailable after the boot image is committed, and retries start a new download.

ota_summary.zh-CN: DNS、连接及收发设置超时，失败或取消后恢复日常服务；提交启动镜像后不能取消，重试从头下载。
ota_summary.en: DNS, connection and I/O have timeouts. Failure or cancellation restores normal services; cancellation is unavailable after the boot image is committed, and retries start a new download.

title.zh-CN: 减少升级期间资源占用
title.en: Reduce resource use during updates

description.zh-CN: 升级期间释放 A1/M1 联动资源，保留 MQTT/HTTP 升级状态与取消响应，并减少日志和 HTTP 的内存开销。
description.en: Updates release A1/M1 binding resources while retaining MQTT/HTTP progress and cancellation responses; logging and HTTP use less memory.

ota_summary.zh-CN: 升级期间释放 A1/M1 联动资源，保留 MQTT/HTTP 升级状态与取消响应，并减少日志和 HTTP 的内存开销。
ota_summary.en: Updates release A1/M1 binding resources while retaining MQTT/HTTP progress and cancellation responses; logging and HTTP use less memory.

title.zh-CN: 修复 TC1 OTA 启动槽校验
title.en: Fix TC1 OTA boot-slot checks

description.zh-CN: 修复 TC1 签名 OTA 的启动槽校验，保留型号、签名及 Flash 读回检查。
description.en: Corrects TC1 signed-OTA boot-slot validation while retaining model, signature and flash readback checks.

ota_summary.zh-CN: 修复 TC1 签名 OTA 的启动槽校验，保留型号、签名及 Flash 读回检查。
ota_summary.en: Corrects TC1 signed-OTA boot-slot validation while retaining model, signature and flash readback checks.

title.zh-CN: HTTPS 与固件验签的边界
title.en: HTTPS and firmware-signature checks

description.zh-CN: 本版 HTTPS 不验证服务器证书；固件签名仍为强制校验。应从可信来源获取升级文件。
description.en: HTTPS in this release does not validate server certificates; firmware-signature verification remains mandatory. Obtain update files from a trusted source.

ota_summary.zh-CN: 本版 HTTPS 不验证服务器证书；固件签名仍为强制校验。应从可信来源获取升级文件。
ota_summary.en: HTTPS in this release does not validate server certificates; firmware-signature verification remains mandatory. Obtain update files from a trusted source.

title.zh-CN: 修正面板与风速灯环反馈
title.en: Correct panel and fan-ring feedback

description.zh-CN: 修正 A1 面板、风速灯环及触摸反馈。
description.en: Corrects A1 panel, fan-speed ring and touch feedback.

ota_summary.zh-CN: 修正 A1 面板、风速灯环及触摸反馈。
ota_summary.en: Corrects A1 panel, fan-speed ring and touch feedback.

ota_summary.zh-CN: 改善 A1/M1 稳定性并为关键线程增加看门狗恢复。
ota_summary.en: Improves A1/M1 stability and adds watchdog recovery for critical threads.

ota_summary.zh-CN: 按风机运行时间累计滤芯使用量，可调整额定寿命并在更换后重置，MQTT 和 Home Assistant 同步显示。

title.zh-CN: 自定义按键与组合键
title.en: Custom button and combination actions

description.zh-CN: 电源键、Wi-Fi 键及双键组合支持自定义连击和长按动作，组合键避免误触单键与网络恢复。

title.en: Improve Home Assistant device information

description.zh-CN: 改善 A1 中文名称、图标及型号，绑定与滤芯实体归属同一设备；滤芯操作仅作用于对应 A1。

ota_summary.en: Improves A1 names, icons and model information. Binding and filter entities belong to the same device; filter actions affect only their own A1.

title.en: Fix migration of unassigned buttons

description.zh-CN: 修复 TC1 旧配置中未分配按键的迁移。

title.en: Independent automatic mode and power

description.zh-CN: 自动/手动模式独立于电源，支持风速上下限、离线风速和夜间范围；手动关机不会被空气质量联动打开。

ota_summary.en: Automatic/manual mode is independent of power, with speed bounds, offline speed and night ranges; air-quality control does not turn a manually powered-off unit back on.

title.zh-CN: 可选启停回差
title.en: Optional start/stop hysteresis

description.zh-CN: PM2.5、甲醛或组合指标可设置启动与目标阈值，配合持续时间及最短运行/待机时间抑制频繁启停；默认关闭。

ota_summary.zh-CN: PM2.5、甲醛或组合指标可设置启动与目标阈值，配合持续时间及最短运行/待机时间抑制频繁启停；默认关闭。

description.zh-CN: 修复自定义亮度且关闭亮度随风速变化时，关机后业务灯效仍亮的问题；保留自动待机与关机的区别。
description.en: Fixes business lights remaining on after shutdown with custom brightness and fan-linked brightness disabled, while preserving the difference between automatic standby and shutdown.

ota_summary.en: Fixes business lights remaining on after shutdown with custom brightness and fan-linked brightness disabled, while preserving the difference between automatic standby and shutdown.

title.zh-CN: 彩色呼吸灯
title.en: Color-cycling breathing light

description.zh-CN: 新增随呼吸明暗逐渐变色的灯效，支持亮度与速度，单色呼吸继续可选。

title.zh-CN: 修复 Home Assistant 开关状态回跳
title.en: Fix Home Assistant switch-state reversion

description.zh-CN: 修复 MQTT/IotCloud 关闭插座后 Home Assistant 又显示打开；控制保存后刷新六路和总开关状态，改名后重新发布发现配置。
description.en: Fixes Home Assistant reverting to on after an outlet is switched off through MQTT/IotCloud. Saved controls refresh all six and master states; renames republish discovery.

ota_summary.zh-CN: 修复 MQTT/IotCloud 关闭插座后 Home Assistant 又显示打开；控制保存后刷新六路和总开关状态，改名后重新发布发现配置。

title.zh-CN: 修复平台气压卡片换行
title.en: Fix platform pressure-card wrapping

description.zh-CN: 修复 IotCloud M1 卡片四位气压读数溢出和换行。
description.en: Fixes overflow and wrapping of four-digit pressure readings on IotCloud M1 cards.

ota_summary.zh-CN: 修复 IotCloud M1 卡片四位气压读数溢出和换行。
ota_summary.en: Fixes overflow and wrapping of four-digit pressure readings on IotCloud M1 cards.

title.zh-CN: 修复 Home Assistant 重新发现权限
title.en: Fix Home Assistant rediscovery permissions

description.zh-CN: 公共 MQTT 服务补齐 Home Assistant 启动通知权限，已有账号同步更新，重新加载集成可触发设备发现。
description.en: The public MQTT service grants Home Assistant startup-notification permissions to existing and new accounts so integration reloads can trigger device discovery.

ota_summary.zh-CN: 公共 MQTT 服务补齐 Home Assistant 启动通知权限，已有账号同步更新，重新加载集成可触发设备发现。
ota_summary.en: The public MQTT service grants Home Assistant startup-notification permissions to existing and new accounts so integration reloads can trigger device discovery.

title.zh-CN: 修复原厂首次迁移启动重启
title.en: Fix startup resets during stock migration

description.zh-CN: 修复原厂配置初始化启动栈不足导致的反复重启。M1 原厂免拆迁移从 0.9.21 开始，首次使用完整版原生 OTA；可能需连接 M1-AP 配网。社区设备继续使用签名包。
description.en: Fixes repeated resets caused by insufficient startup stack during stock-configuration initialization. M1 stock migration starts at 0.9.21 and initially requires the full native OTA image; Wi-Fi setup through M1-AP may be needed. Community devices continue using signed packages.

ota_summary.zh-CN: 修复原厂配置初始化启动栈不足导致的反复重启。M1 原厂免拆迁移从 0.9.21 开始，首次使用完整版原生 OTA；可能需连接 M1-AP 配网。社区设备继续使用签名包。
ota_summary.en: Fixes repeated resets caused by insufficient startup stack during stock-configuration initialization. M1 stock migration starts at 0.9.21 and initially requires the full native OTA image; Wi-Fi setup through M1-AP may be needed. Community devices continue using signed packages.

title.zh-CN: A1 PWM 统一为 25 kHz
title.en: A1 PWM uses 25 kHz

description.zh-CN: A1 PWM 频率统一为 25 kHz，普通版保留原风机驱动板映射。
description.en: A1 PWM runs at 25 kHz; the standard variant retains the original fan-driver mapping.

ota_summary.zh-CN: A1 PWM 频率统一为 25 kHz，普通版保留原风机驱动板映射。
ota_summary.en: A1 PWM runs at 25 kHz; the standard variant retains the original fan-driver mapping.

title.zh-CN: 可选新风固件与独立风机
title.en: Optional fresh-air firmware and second fan

description.zh-CN: 新风版使用串口 TX 输出 PWM、RX 接收转速，需兼容风扇和正确接线；支持独立电源、手动/自动、极性与输出映射，默认每转 2 脉冲，MQTT 与 Home Assistant 提供新风实体。
description.en: The fresh-air variant uses serial TX for PWM and RX for tachometer input and requires compatible wiring and fans. It supports independent power, manual/automatic mode, polarity and output mapping, defaults to two pulses per revolution, and exposes fresh-air MQTT/Home Assistant entities.

ota_summary.zh-CN: 新风版使用串口 TX 输出 PWM、RX 接收转速，需兼容风扇和正确接线；支持独立电源、手动/自动、极性与输出映射，默认每转 2 脉冲，MQTT 与 Home Assistant 提供新风实体。
ota_summary.en: The fresh-air variant uses serial TX for PWM and RX for tachometer input and requires compatible wiring and fans. It supports independent power, manual/automatic mode, polarity and output mapping, defaults to two pulses per revolution, and exposes fresh-air MQTT/Home Assistant entities.

title.zh-CN: 双风机联动策略
title.en: Dual-fan coupling policies

description.zh-CN: 新风可独立调速、按原风机比例限制，或提高原风机最低转速；整机关机关闭两路，保留已有联动设置。
description.en: Fresh-air speed can be independent, limited by the main fan or raise the main fan’s minimum speed. Powering off the unit stops both channels and preserves existing binding settings.

ota_summary.zh-CN: 新风可独立调速、按原风机比例限制，或提高原风机最低转速；整机关机关闭两路，保留已有联动设置。
ota_summary.en: Fresh-air speed can be independent, limited by the main fan or raise the main fan’s minimum speed. Powering off the unit stops both channels and preserves existing binding settings.

title.zh-CN: 统一两路自动调速设置
title.en: Unified automatic settings for both fans

description.zh-CN: 原风机和新风自动设置合并到同一页，使用 PM2.5、甲醛、CO₂ 多选框，改善切换与受限时的控制。
description.en: Main and fresh-air automatic settings share a page with PM2.5, formaldehyde and CO₂ checkboxes, improving switching and control under limits.

ota_summary.zh-CN: 原风机和新风自动设置合并到同一页，使用 PM2.5、甲醛、CO₂ 多选框，改善切换与受限时的控制。
ota_summary.en: Main and fresh-air automatic settings share a page with PM2.5, formaldehyde and CO₂ checkboxes, improving switching and control under limits.

title.zh-CN: 减少新风配置开销
title.en: Reduce fresh-air configuration overhead

description.zh-CN: 减少策略配置的临时分配和网页占用，保留 16 KiB 内存保护；高负载仍可能返回 busy。
description.en: Reduces temporary policy allocations and page size, retains the 16 KiB memory guard and may still return busy under heavy load.

ota_summary.zh-CN: 减少策略配置的临时分配和网页占用，保留 16 KiB 内存保护；高负载仍可能返回 busy。
ota_summary.en: Reduces temporary policy allocations and page size, retains the 16 KiB memory guard and may still return busy under heavy load.

title.zh-CN: 新风接线与启动阶段限制
title.en: Fresh-air wiring and startup limitations

description.zh-CN: 新风冷上电和引导阶段不能保证关机电平；使用前需确认兼容接线。完整版 OTA 空间很小，可选择保留配网页的新风精简版。
description.en: The off level is not guaranteed during fresh-air cold power-on or boot; confirm compatible wiring before use. Full-variant OTA space is very limited; a fresh-air minimal variant retains setup pages.

ota_summary.zh-CN: 新风冷上电和引导阶段不能保证关机电平；使用前需确认兼容接线。完整版 OTA 空间很小，可选择保留配网页的新风精简版。
ota_summary.en: The off level is not guaranteed during fresh-air cold power-on or boot; confirm compatible wiring before use. Full-variant OTA space is very limited; a fresh-air minimal variant retains setup pages.

title.zh-CN: DAIKIN 通用固件
title.en: Universal DAIKIN firmware

description.zh-CN: 新增 DAIKIN BRY88AX151K 的 ESP32 通用完整版固件，共用本地网页、MQTT 和传感器会话协议；自动识别 PM2005 / PM2105 与可选甲醛模块，无甲醛模块时隐藏读数。
description.en: Adds universal full ESP32 firmware for DAIKIN BRY88AX151K with the shared local UI, MQTT and sensor-session protocol. PM2005 / PM2105 and the optional formaldehyde module are detected automatically; absent formaldehyde readings are hidden.

ota_summary.zh-CN: 新增 DAIKIN BRY88AX151K 的 ESP32 通用完整版固件，共用本地网页、MQTT 和传感器会话协议；自动识别 PM2005 / PM2105 与可选甲醛模块，无甲醛模块时隐藏读数。
ota_summary.en: Adds universal full ESP32 firmware for DAIKIN BRY88AX151K with the shared local UI, MQTT and sensor-session protocol. PM2005 / PM2105 and the optional formaldehyde module are detected automatically; absent formaldehyde readings are hidden.

title.zh-CN: DAIKIN 空气质量概览
title.en: DAIKIN air quality overview

description.zh-CN: 以单行传感器卡片和舒适度条展示 PM2.5、独立 PM10、温湿度、CO₂、TVOC 及已连接设备；TVOC 提供 300 ppb 通风参考，固定大小的指标胶囊适配长文案。
description.en: A single row of sensor cards and comfort scales shows PM2.5, a separate PM10 card, temperature, humidity, CO₂, TVOC and connected devices. TVOC includes a 300 ppb ventilation reference; fixed-size badges accommodate longer labels.

ota_summary.zh-CN: 以单行传感器卡片和舒适度条展示 PM2.5、独立 PM10、温湿度、CO₂、TVOC 及已连接设备；TVOC 提供 300 ppb 通风参考，固定大小的指标胶囊适配长文案。
ota_summary.en: A single row of sensor cards and comfort scales shows PM2.5, a separate PM10 card, temperature, humidity, CO₂, TVOC and connected devices. TVOC includes a 300 ppb ventilation reference; fixed-size badges accommodate longer labels.

title.zh-CN: A1 根据实际数据执行联动
title.en: A1 automation uses available provider data

description.zh-CN: A1 联动使用提供方实际可用的数据，支持 DAIKIN 等提供方，不再绑定对方型号；缺失或过期的数据不参与控制，原有绑定和联动配置保持兼容。
description.en: A1 automation consumes available provider data, including DAIKIN readings, without requiring a particular provider model. Missing or stale readings do not control the device; existing bindings and automation settings remain compatible.

ota_summary.zh-CN: A1 联动使用提供方实际可用的数据，支持 DAIKIN 等提供方，不再绑定对方型号；缺失或过期的数据不参与控制，原有绑定和联动配置保持兼容。
ota_summary.en: A1 automation consumes available provider data, including DAIKIN readings, without requiring a particular provider model. Missing or stale readings do not control the device; existing bindings and automation settings remain compatible.

title.zh-CN: 自动化选项随可用读数显示
title.en: Automation options follow available readings

description.zh-CN: A1 自动化设置仅显示提供方能够提供的读数选项；缺失对应数据时隐藏该选项，保留已有配置。
description.en: A1 automation settings show options for readings the provider can supply. Options for unavailable readings are hidden while existing settings are retained.

ota_summary.zh-CN: A1 自动化设置仅显示提供方能够提供的读数选项；缺失对应数据时隐藏该选项，保留已有配置。
ota_summary.en: A1 automation settings show options for readings the provider can supply. Options for unavailable readings are hidden while existing settings are retained.

title.zh-CN: 在线下载使用内核 TLS
title.en: Online downloads use kernel TLS

description.zh-CN: A1、M1、TC1 在线下载改用内核 TLS，支持短读、短写及非阻塞等待，并限制握手、取消和总下载时间；失败和重试释放 TLS 会话与 socket。HTTPS 仍不校验证书，OTA 固件签名继续强制验证。
description.en: A1, M1 and TC1 downloads use kernel TLS with short-read/write handling, nonblocking waits, handshake and overall deadlines, cancellation, and session/socket cleanup on failure and retry. HTTPS still does not validate certificates; OTA firmware signatures remain mandatory.

ota_summary.zh-CN: A1、M1、TC1 在线下载改用内核 TLS，支持短读、短写及非阻塞等待，并限制握手、取消和总下载时间；失败和重试释放 TLS 会话与 socket。HTTPS 仍不校验证书，OTA 固件签名继续强制验证。
ota_summary.en: A1, M1 and TC1 downloads use kernel TLS with short-read/write handling, nonblocking waits, handshake and overall deadlines, cancellation, and session/socket cleanup on failure and retry. HTTPS still does not validate certificates; OTA firmware signatures remain mandatory.

title.zh-CN: 修复 TC1 低内存下的本地按键
title.en: Fix TC1 local buttons under memory pressure

description.zh-CN: TC1 本地按键直接执行控制，修复低内存时 JSON 状态查询失败导致按键动作被丢弃的问题。
description.en: TC1 local buttons execute controls directly, fixing lost button actions when JSON status queries fail under memory pressure.

ota_summary.zh-CN: TC1 本地按键直接执行控制，修复低内存时 JSON 状态查询失败导致按键动作被丢弃的问题。
ota_summary.en: TC1 local buttons execute controls directly, fixing lost button actions when JSON status queries fail under memory pressure.

title.zh-CN: 恢复 TC1 未配置的 MQTT 默认值
title.en: Restore unconfigured TC1 MQTT defaults

description.zh-CN: 修复 TC1 未配置 MQTT 主机时，端口为 0 的默认配置不能通过配置接口恢复的问题。
description.en: Fixes the configuration API rejecting the default port of 0 when no MQTT host is configured on TC1.

ota_summary.zh-CN: 修复 TC1 未配置 MQTT 主机时，端口为 0 的默认配置不能通过配置接口恢复的问题。
ota_summary.en: Fixes the configuration API rejecting the default port of 0 when no MQTT host is configured on TC1.

title.zh-CN: 官网审核历史和升级差异
title.en: Reviewed website history and upgrade comparisons

title.zh-CN: 从设备网页查看升级差异
title.en: Open upgrade comparisons from the device UI

description.zh-CN: 完整版固件设置增加官网升级差异入口，携带真实版本和固件类型。说明由浏览器计算，设备不保存发布历史或增加说明下载任务；官网可选读取一次设备信息，失败时保留手动选择，密码不保存。

The browser computes notes without storing history or downloading notes on the device. Optional one-shot device identification retains manual selection on failure and never stores the password.

ota_summary.zh-CN: 完整版固件设置增加官网升级差异入口，携带真实版本和固件类型。说明由浏览器计算，设备不保存发布历史或增加说明下载任务；官网可选读取一次设备信息，失败时保留手动选择，密码不保存。
ota_summary.en: Full UI firmware settings link to website upgrade comparisons with the real version and firmware variant. The browser computes notes without storing history or downloading notes on the device. Optional one-shot device identification retains manual selection on failure and never stores the password.

title.zh-CN: 大金可持久保存指示灯规则
title.en: Persistent DAIKIN indicator rules

description.zh-CN: CO₂、TVOC、PM 各支持最多两组阈值及常亮、常灭、快闪、慢闪；PM 灯选择 PM2.5 或 PM10 为数据源。检测到甲醛模块后可配置甲醛规则。规则重启保留，未命中或读数过期时熄灯。
description.en: CO₂, TVOC and PM each support up to two thresholds with steady on/off and fast/slow blink. The PM lamp selects PM2.5 or PM10. Formaldehyde rules are available when its module is detected. Rules survive restart; unmatched or stale readings turn the lamp off.

ota_summary.zh-CN: CO₂、TVOC、PM 各支持最多两组阈值及常亮、常灭、快闪、慢闪；PM 灯选择 PM2.5 或 PM10 为数据源。检测到甲醛模块后可配置甲醛规则。规则重启保留，未命中或读数过期时熄灯。

title.zh-CN: 大金指示灯规则设置页
title.en: DAIKIN indicator settings page

description.zh-CN: 在设置 → 通用设置 → 指示灯规则中编辑阈值、条件和四种灯效，选择 PM 数据源；概览显示当前灯效并保留刷新过程中的闪烁节奏。

title.zh-CN: 大金 Wi-Fi 灯指示系统状态
title.en: DAIKIN Wi-Fi lamp shows system state

title.en: Consistent DAIKIN recovery hotspot

title.zh-CN: Safari 不再重复提示添加到桌面

description.zh-CN: A1 Wi-Fi 键新增保留恢复组合：短按两次，第 3 次按住 1–2 秒后松手重置网络；短按三次，第 4 次按住 1–2 秒后松手恢复出厂。每次短按须松手，相邻触碰间隔小于 0.3 秒，最终按住至少 1 秒、不足 5 秒，面板报告松开才触发。绕过童锁，不执行本组连击或最终长按的自定义动作；原 5 秒 / 10 秒恢复手势保留。恢复出厂清除用户设置。此补充手势仍为测试功能。
description.en: A1 reserves two Wi-Fi recovery sequences: tap twice, hold the third touch for 1–2 seconds and release to reset networking; tap three times, hold the fourth touch for 1–2 seconds and release to factory reset. Release each short tap, leave less than 0.3 seconds between touches and hold the final touch for at least 1 second and less than 5 seconds. Recovery runs only when the panel reports release, bypasses child lock and suppresses custom click and hold actions for this sequence. Existing 5 / 10 second recovery holds remain. Factory reset clears user settings. These alternative sequences remain experimental.
